## Checklist

- [ ] `composer check` passes (Pint, PHPStan, PHPUnit)
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` passes, if the client runtime changed
- [ ] `npm run build` was run and `dist/` is committed, if `src/js/` changed
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour
- [ ] `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` updated where relevant
- [ ] Breaking changes are documented in `UPGRADE.md`
